messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a rollforward rebuild of base image (base-2024). Need coordination for RBAC updates to the signer, KMS access controls, and audit-log retention. Target window: Tue 03:00 UTC. Who's available for signoff and oncall handover?

sam: I'm infra oncall that window. What exact RBAC change do you need?

maria: Short list: 1) Add build service account to signer role (least-privileged binding), 2) Ensure KMS key ACL only allows Encrypt/Decrypt for signer principal and operator, 3) Forward KMS and registry audit logs to SecureLogs project with 2y retention, 4) Canary 5% traffic, 5) Vulnerability triage for patched glibc/CVE-2024-XXXX. Also cosign key rotation schedule.

aisling: For the RBAC piece I'd prefer a short-lived binding via OIDC / ServiceAccount token (no long-lived keys). I'll draft a RoleBinding that scopes to the infra-build namespace and limits verbs.

kevin: For audit logs please include build metadata in the payload (commit/PR, image-digest, operator) so we can trace a rollout later. Also confirm whether audit logs preserve identity (no anonymization).

devops-bot: deploybot: Canary request accepted — configured base-2024 -> 5% traffic in canary pool. Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/image-rollforward (ops notes attached). :gear:

sec-oncall: I'll own vuln triage with Jenna. Jenna, can you run regression evals on the NLP stacks against the rebuilt image (libc bump)? Need perf + correctness.

jenna: Yep — will run the eval suite tonight. Need the image digest and a small sample prompt list. ETA ~4h.

maria: Docker manifest and digest: gcr.io/redwood/base-images/base-2024@sha256:abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890
Pull command: `docker pull gcr.io/redwood/base-images/base-2024@sha256:abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890`

sam: Draft RBAC manifest (preview):
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: build-signer-bind
  namespace: infra-build
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: image-signer
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: build-bot
  namespace: infra-build
```
I'll tighten it to only allow `signImage` verb and scope to the cosign controller.

aisling: I'll convert that into an OIDC-backed short-lived binding and add an annotation for expiration (7d). Also will include an admission policy that denies any binding to wildcard subjects.

sec-oncall: KMS side: please ensure the key policy explicitly lists principals (no `allUsers`). Enable KMS audit log export: `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/releases/keys/cosign-key -> SecureLogs sink`. I want both ADMIN_READ and DATA_WRITE logged.

kevin: One operational question — rollback path? If canary surface increases error rate how do we route back?

maria: Rollback plan: SmartRouting flag will switch service groups back to base-2023. Runbook step: `routing set base-image base-2023` and the canary controller will auto-revert if `image.canary.error_rate > 1%` sustained for 10m. We'll also keep the previous image tagged and signed for immediate revert.

devops-bot: monitoring: alert `image.canary.error_rate` configured -> threshold 1% for 10m -> page infra-oncall.

jenna: Started evals against the pulled digest (running regressions). I'll post perf numbers and diffed outputs in this thread when done.

maria: Also requirement: attach SBOM to the image artifact and cosign the SBOM. I'll push SBOM to artifacts and link it in the PR.

sec-oncall: Confirmed — SBOM must include package versions and source commit ids. Also require CVE scan report attached to the artifact. If any high severity >0 for runtime deps, hold the rollout.

sam: Acked — infra will prepare the signer role change PR and KMS sink.

aisling: Acked — drafting OIDC RoleBinding PR and admission constraint.

kevin: Acked for audit/logging requirements, will ensure metadata is included.

maria: Thanks. If no blockers by EOD UTC today we proceed with Tue window. @sam @aisling @kevin please post PR links here so sec-oncall and ops can review.

jenna: Posted interim results: small perf variance +0.3% p50, no functional diffs in 500 sample prompts. Will upload full report shortly.

sec-oncall: Looks good so far. Waiting on RBAC PR and KMS sink confirmation before final signoff.

maria: Great — I'll update the runbook with the explicit rollback steps and link PRs when available.

sam: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/merge_requests/1234 — includes RoleBinding + cosign controller permission narrowing.

aisling: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/policies/merge_requests/987 — admission constraint + OIDC binding.

sec-oncall: Reviewing PRs now. If all green I'll mark final signoff in this thread.

jenna: Full report uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/reports/base-2024-regression-172930 — no severity-0 regressions, CVEs addressed in glibc patch.

sec-oncall: Final signoff — vuln triage looks clean, audit and KMS changes approved. Proceed with scheduled rollforward. :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks team. I'll kick the preflight tomorrow 02:00 UTC and then the rollforward at 03:00 UTC. Will ping here for live updates.
